L107: 【38†The Show】 Chart is a 【39†music program】 【40†record chart】 on SBS M that gives an award to the best-performing 【41†single】 of the week in South Korea.^{【42†[1]】}
L108: 
L109: In 2024, 23 songs placed number one on the chart and 18 acts have been awarded a first-place trophy.
